_comment: Pre-registered settings of the Week 10 experiment (docs/Week10_Experiment_Design_Shkirpan.md). Fixed before any pattern was mined on the real data. The test year is read only by the `test` stage, once, after tuning has written analysis/locked_params.json.
unit: one in-scope pedestrian death (one row of v_ped_transactions)

candidate.method: FP-Growth closed frequent itemsets (mlxtend.frequent_patterns.fpgrowth), lift ranking
candidate.selection_rule: minimise validation MAE of the candidate at K = top_k; require at least top_k patterns; ties -> larger min_support, then larger min_lift

secondary_analyses: roadway top-K: pre-specified after tuning and before the test run, on seeing the fit-years pattern list; reported as secondary

baseline.method: statistical independence: predicted support of an itemset = product of the single-item supports measured on the fit years (lift == 1 by construction)

metrics.primary: MAE_pp: mean absolute error, in percentage points, between predicted and observed hold-out support over the top-K patterns
secondary: replication_rate: share of top-K patterns with hold-out support >= min_support and hold-out lift > 1
signed_bias_pp: mean (predicted - observed) support in percentage points
spearman_rank: rank correlation of fit-years lift vs hold-out lift over the top-K patterns
coverage: share of hold-out deaths covered by at least one top-K pattern

uncertainty.bootstrap_unit: crash (year, st_case) within the evaluated year

permutation_null.method: column-wise permutation of each item variable within the fit years (swap randomisation that preserves every item support and every transaction length)
statistics: number of patterns passing min_support and min_lift
replication_rate of the top-K under the null

subgroups.county_group: five most populous counties by 2020-2024 person-years vs all other counties
subgroups.sensitivity: alcohol_stratum: 'no alcohol reported' only vs all deaths (never reported as a clean split; the unknown share is printed next to it)
